permissions.reportAuthoring: Read and write access to the target SRE Agent
permissions.sourceData: Read-only access to the approved Azure scope and Log Analytics workspace

dataSources.scope: Resolved workspace bindings and approved inventoryComputerNames

requiredChecks: No unresolved bindings or copied snapshot inventory
Latest observation per machine, software name, publisher and software type
Freshness and collection limitations shown separately from version status
Newer installed version means AheadOfPolicy, never Outdated
Result limits and partial data are visible; counts specify their unit
No software install, removal or deployment actions

dataSources.connector: Azure resource read / Azure Resource Graph
resources: Update Manager assessments and installation results
Azure Arc SQL inventory where available

dataSources.scope: Resolved workspace bindings and approved inventoryComputerNames

requiredChecks: Live source queries, not an embedded ARG snapshot
Per-source retrieval and observation timestamps shown
Planned-offline machines separated from unexpected disconnections
Approved release-ring policy and expiring exceptions, not fixed latest-version claims
OS and SQL lifecycle findings cite verified support and entitlement evidence
Missing tables, failed queries, stale data and truncated results are visible
No patch, reboot, upgrade, extension change or Run Command actions

naming.reuse: Reuse a saved report only after its name, agent, scope and blueprint version are verified; keep generated report IDs in private deployment output.
